summary: Introduces Python 2 vs 3 differences that affect Jinja2 templates in Ansible, to help write portable templates or upgrade.
questions: Do my Ansible templates behave differently on Python 3?

answer_card.title: Python versions and templates
answer_card.answer_md: Jinja2 exposes Python data types and functions, so some template behavior differs between **Python 2 and Python 3**. Upgrading within the same major version rarely affects templates.
